000229b1-9ea9-4303-a79b-9ff24d1a8532.title: WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging < 0.9.138 - Authenticated (Administrator+) Path Traversal

software.name: WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging
software.remediation: Update to version 0.9.138, or a newer patched version

000229b1-9ea9-4303-a79b-9ff24d1a8532.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Path Traversal in all versions up to 0.9.138. This is due to insufficient validation of a user supplied path. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to access files and directories outside of the intended directory.

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
cwe.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory.

00086b84-c1ec-447a-a536-1c73eac1cc85.title: MOLIE <= 0.5 - SQL Injection

software.name: MOLIE – Instructure Canvas Linking tool
software.remediation: No known patch available. Please review the vulnerability's details in depth and employ mitigations based on your organization's risk tolerance. It may be best to uninstall the affected software and find a replacement.

00086b84-c1ec-447a-a536-1c73eac1cc85.description: The MOLIE WordPress plugin through 0.5 does not validate and escape a post parameter before using in a SQL statement, leading to an SQL Injection

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended SQL command when it is sent to a downstream component. Without sufficient removal or quoting of SQL syntax in user-controllable inputs, the generated SQL query can cause those inputs to be interpreted as SQL instead of ordinary user data.

00376356-4a85-4898-a101-710e1cb5c6bb.title: WordPress Core <= 3.3 - Cross-Site Scripting

software.name: WordPress
software.remediation: Update to version 3.3.1, or a newer patched version

00376356-4a85-4898-a101-710e1cb5c6bb.description: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in wp-comments-post.php in WordPress 3.3.x before 3.3.1, when Internet Explorer is used, allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the query string in a POST operation that is not properly handled by the "Duplicate comment detected" feature.

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
cwe.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

0012eb8d-4a40-42d4-94af-307ce7d23e5f.title: Orpheus <= 1.8 - Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection

software.name: Orpheus
software.remediation: No known patch available. Please review the vulnerability's details in depth and employ mitigations based on your organization's risk tolerance. It may be best to uninstall the affected software and find a replacement.

0012eb8d-4a40-42d4-94af-307ce7d23e5f.description: The Orpheus theme for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 1.8. This is due to deserialization of untrusted input. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it could allow the attacker to delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code.

cwe.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
cwe.description: The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently ensuring that the resulting data will be valid.
